verdict.rationale: Casium's own visa guides touch on some fallback paths. The O-1A is framed as an option for candidates not selected in the H-1B lottery, and the International Entrepreneur Parole guide covers that interim route, including its criticisms. Nothing in the pack addresses running the company remotely while waiting, Canadian or other non-US interim options, or what happens after a denial. Missing for 10: guidance on operating the company remotely while waiting, Canadian or third-country interim options, post-denial next steps (appeals, refiling, alternatives), and any independent corroboration of how candid the materials are.
